lines.text: Whoa... I've got feathers. Real feathers!
So... how do I ride it?
Oh. I sort of assumed you knew.
Okay! Left foot down. Then right. Eyes on the road.
Hey, everybody! The pelican's ridin' a bicycle!
Don't look at your feet. Look where you want to go.
I'm doing it... I'm doing it! I'm actually doing it!
Okay, okay. Not bad... for a guy with a bucket on his face.
Hey, uh... quick question. Did you draw brakes?
Brakes! The things that make it stop!
End of the pier! End of the pier!
I don't need brakes... I've got WINGS!
I'm sorry about the brakes. I'm still learning.
